betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The Wooden Crank is your first tool for powering the Quartz Grindstone. Attach it to the top of the grindstone and right-click to turn it.

Each right-click counts as one crank turn. The grindstone needs a certain number of turns to complete a recipe (varies by recipe, usually 4-8 turns). The crank has limited durability and will break after extended use, so craft a few spares.

Once you get rotational power from other tech mods like BuildCraft or Thermal Expansion, you can skip the crank entirely and automate your grinding.

§ePS:§f The crank is cheap to make. Wood and sticks. You will go through a few before you automate.
